headline: Argentina October Inflation Prints at 1.8% as Market Expects Firm Price Growth
summary: Argentina's central bank released its Market Expectations Survey showing October inflation at 1.8%, with market participants anticipating sticky inflation over the next six months alongside lower dollar value estimates.
why: Inflation expectations surveys are closely watched by investors to gauge future monetary policy adjustments and currency depreciation trends in emerging markets.
